summary: Frontend-only regression on second iteration of Arabic RTL Saudi Embassy transactions site. Tested new logo, adaptive header contrast, hero slider, nav links, expanded service cards (no 01/02 numbers), testimonials, blog list + article routing (via click and direct URL), 404 page, legal pages, WhatsApp/phone links, mobile menu, responsive overflow at 1440/768/390, and SEO assets (sitemap.xml, logo.png). 51/51 real assertions passed; 0 console errors on home, blog article, legal, and 404. All new features work as specified.
critical_code_review_comments: Header contrast implementation verified: at scrollY=0 nav-link color=rgba(255,255,255,0.85) on transparent bg; after scroll color=rgba(1,59,30,0.8) on rgba(255,255,255,0.8) bg — good contrast in both states.
All 6 WhatsApp CTAs + blogpost CTA correctly link to https://wa.me/962792622210 with pre-filled Arabic message.
Services section confirmed clear of 01/02 numeric badges; each card has 'كيف نعمل:' line and points chips.
Blog routing works both via click navigation and direct URL entry (/blog/saudi-work-visa-guide).
404 page renders correctly for unknown routes and 'العودة للرئيسية' returns to /.
Mobile menu includes all required links including blog and testimonials (visually verified via screenshot).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Second iteration passed 100%. When testing header color state, use desktop viewport (>=1024px) and select [data-testid=nav-link-services] specifically — on mobile the same testid exists in the hidden slide-out menu and returns dark color even at top, which can cause false negatives. For mobile menu visibility checks prefer taking a screenshot or checking DOM presence rather than offsetParent, because the fixed-overlay menu may report offsetParent=null despite being visible.
